description: Lists the cast in 3D: the six people (bob, ria, sunny, sam, lee, rose) and the animals (dog, cat, fox, horse, gull, and bear2, fox2, rabbit2, raccoon2, cat2 on two legs), each with the designed entry a cast entry gives it and a voice; the voices a line can use; and cartoon_example, a whole talking cartoon to copy. (The six flat templates of older cartoons are listed too, as characters.) Call it to write a cast: {"dog": {"name": "Biscuit", "look": {"template": "dog", "colors": {"skin": "#8d6e63"}}, "voice": "am_puck"}}.
name: list_characters
